source.text: לֹֽא־תַעֲשׂ֨וּ לָכֶ֜ם אֱלִילִ֗ם וּפֶ֤סֶל וּמַצֵּבָה֙ לֹֽא־תָקִ֣ימוּ לָכֶ֔ם וְאֶ֣בֶן מַשְׂכִּ֗ית לֹ֤א תִתְּנוּ֙ בְּאַרְצְכֶ֔ם לְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֖ת עָלֶ֑יהָ כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Not you will make for yourselves worthless idols, and a carved image and a standing stone not you will set up for yourselves, and a stone of carving not you will put in your land to bow down to it; for I [am] Yahweh your God.

en.L: You shall not make for yourselves worthless idols, and a carved image or a standing stone you shall not set up for yourselves, and a carved stone you shall not put in your land to bow down to it; for I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God.
en.B: Do not make worthless idols for yourselves, and do not set up a carved image or a sacred pillar. Do not place a stone carved with images anywhere in your land in order to bow down before it, for I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God.
en.R: Do not make idols. Do not set up statues of gods or stone pillars for worship. Do not put stones with carved pictures on them in your land so that you can bow down to them. I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God.

es.L: No {{plural_you:harán|haréis}} para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} ídolos inútiles, ni {{plural_you:levantarán|levantaréis}} para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} imagen tallada ni estela, ni {{plural_you:pondrán|pondréis}} en {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} tierra piedra labrada para {{plural_you:postrarse|postraros}} ante ella; porque yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Dios.
es.B: No {{plural_you:se fabriquen|os fabriquéis}} ídolos sin valor, ni {{plural_you:levanten|levantéis}} ídolo tallado ni piedra erguida. No {{plural_you:coloquen|coloquéis}} en ningún lugar de {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} tierra una piedra grabada con figuras para {{plural_you:inclinarse|inclinaros}} ante ella, porque yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Dios.
es.R: No {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}} ídolos. No {{plural_you:levanten|levantéis}} estatuas de dioses ni pilares de piedra para adorarlos. No {{plural_you:pongan|pongáis}} en {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} tierra piedras con figuras talladas para {{plural_you:inclinarse|inclinaros}} ante ellas. Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Dios.

fr.L: Vous ne vous ferez pas d’idoles de néant, et vous ne vous dresserez ni image sculptée ni stèle, et vous ne mettrez pas dans votre pays de pierre sculptée pour vous prosterner devant elle ; car je [suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu.
fr.B: Vous ne vous fabriquerez pas d’idoles sans valeur, et vous n’élèverez ni idole taillée ni pierre dressée. Vous ne placerez nulle part dans votre pays de pierre gravée de figures pour vous incliner devant elle, car je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu.
fr.R: Ne fabriquez pas d’idoles. N’élevez pas de statues de dieux ni de piliers de pierre pour les adorer. Ne mettez pas dans votre pays de pierres où sont gravées des images, pour vous prosterner devant elles. Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu.

sw.L: Msijifanyie sanamu zisizofaa kitu, wala msijisimamishie sanamu ya kuchonga wala nguzo, wala msiweke katika nchi yenu jiwe la kuchongwa ili kulisujudia; kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu.
sw.B: Msijitengenezee sanamu zisizo na thamani, wala msisimamishe sanamu iliyochongwa au jiwe lililosimikwa. Msiweke popote katika nchi yenu jiwe lililochongwa picha ili mlisujudie, kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu.
sw.R: Msitengeneze sanamu za kuabudu. Msisimamishe sanamu za miungu wala nguzo za mawe za ibada. Msiweke katika nchi yenu mawe yenye picha zilizochongwa ili myasujudie. Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu.

decisions.choice: worthless idols, a carved image, a standing stone, a carved stone: every kind of object made for worship
decisions.reason: The first word means "nothings", things of no worth, and is a mocking name for idols (19:4; Psalm 96:5). A carved image is a figure cut from wood or stone (Exodus 20:4). A standing stone was a pillar set up at a place of worship, which Israel was to tear down (Exodus 23:24; Deuteronomy 16:22). A carved stone is a slab cut with figures; the rare word appears again in Numbers 33:52. Together they cover every object one might bow down to.

decisions.choice: the chapter opens by restating the heart of the covenant
decisions.reason: Verses 1-2 still belong to the speech that began on Mount Sinai in 25:1. Before the blessings and curses they repeat the first commandments, no idols (19:4; Exodus 20:4-5) and the keeping of the Sabbath and the sanctuary (verse 2), as the terms on which the promises that follow rest.

decisions.choice: statues of gods ... stone pillars for worship ... stones with carved pictures
decisions.reason: Readable describes the objects instead of naming them. Literal says "standing stone" and "carved stone"; Balanced "sacred pillar" and "a stone carved with images".

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} spans and plural verbs throughout the chapter, at every level
decisions.reason: The whole chapter addresses all Israel in the plural ("you shall not make" is plural here), so every "you" verb, pronoun and possessive carries the plural_you setting, Readable included.

decisions.choice: "vous" throughout the chapter, at every level
decisions.reason: From verse 1 to verse 45 God addresses all Israel with plural verbs and pronouns. Readable elsewhere in Leviticus may address one worshiper as "tu", but here the Hebrew is plural and the warnings fall on the whole people, so "vous" stays at every level.

decisions.choice: plural forms throughout the chapter: "msijifanyie", "mtazishika", "nchi yenu"
decisions.reason: From verse 1 to verse 45 the Hebrew addresses all Israel in the plural, so Swahili uses the plural subject prefix m- and the plural possessive -enu at every level, Readable included.

source.text: אֶת־שַׁבְּתֹתַ֣י תִּשְׁמֹ֔רוּ וּמִקְדָּשִׁ֖י תִּירָ֑אוּ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: My sabbaths you will keep, and my sanctuary you will fear; I [am] Yahweh.

en.L: You shall keep {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sabbaths, and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sanctuary you shall fear; I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: You are to keep {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Sabbaths and stand in awe of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sanctuary. I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Keep {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Sabbath days, and respect {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sanctuary. I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: {{plural_you:Guardarán|Guardaréis}} {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} sábados, y {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} santuario {{plural_you:temerán|temeréis}}; yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: {{plural_you:Guardarán|Guardaréis}} {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} sábados y {{plural_you:tendrán|tendréis}} gran reverencia por {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} santuario. Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: {{plural_you:Guarden|Guardad}} {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} días de descanso y {{plural_you:respeten|respetad}} {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} santuario. Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Vous garderez {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} sabbats, et {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} sanctuaire, vous le craindrez ; je [suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Vous observerez {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} sabbats, et vous aurez un profond respect pour {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} sanctuaire. Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Observez {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} jours de sabbat, et respectez {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} sanctuaire. Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Mtazishika Sabato {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}, na mahali {{deity_pronoun:pangu|Pangu}} patakatifu mtapacha; {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Mtazishika Sabato {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} na kupaheshimu sana mahali {{deity_pronoun:pangu|Pangu}} patakatifu. Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Shikeni siku {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} za Sabato, na mpaheshimu mahali {{deity_pronoun:pangu|Pangu}} patakatifu. Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

decisions.choice: my sabbaths ... my sanctuary: the same words as 19:30
decisions.reason: The verse repeats 19:30 word for word. "Sabbaths" may include the sabbath years of chapter 25 as well as the weekly day (see 26:34). To fear the sanctuary is to treat God's dwelling with reverence, keeping its rules of holiness; see the note at 19:30.

decisions.choice: stand in awe of (Balanced); respect (Readable)
decisions.reason: The verb is "fear", here the reverence owed to what is holy, not terror. Literal keeps "fear".

source.text: אִם־בְּחֻקֹּתַ֖י תֵּלֵ֑כוּ וְאֶת־מִצְוֺתַ֣י תִּשְׁמְר֔וּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: If in my statutes you walk, and my commandments you keep and do them,

en.L: If in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} statutes you walk, and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} commandments you keep and do them,
en.B: If you live by {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} statutes and faithfully keep {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} commandments,
en.R: Suppose you live by {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} laws and carefully obey {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} commands.

es.L: Si en {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} estatutos {{plural_you:andan|andáis}}, y {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} mandamientos {{plural_you:guardan|guardáis}} y los {{plural_you:ponen|ponéis}} por obra,
es.B: Si {{plural_you:viven|vivís}} conforme a {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} estatutos y {{plural_you:guardan|guardáis}} fielmente {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} mandamientos,
es.R: Supongamos que {{plural_you:viven|vivís}} según {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} leyes y {{plural_you:obedecen|obedecéis}} con cuidado {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} mandamientos.

fr.L: Si vous marchez dans {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} prescriptions, et si vous gardez {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} commandements et les pratiquez,
fr.B: Si vous vivez selon {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} prescriptions et gardez fidèlement {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} commandements,
fr.R: Supposons que vous viviez selon {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} lois et que vous obéissiez avec soin à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} commandements.

sw.L: Mkienenda katika kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}, na mkizishika amri {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} na kuzitenda,
sw.B: Mkiishi kwa kufuata kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} na kuzishika amri {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} kwa uaminifu,
sw.R: Tuseme mnaishi kwa kufuata sheria {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} na mnazitii amri {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} kwa uangalifu.

decisions.choice: walk in my statutes: live one's whole life by them
decisions.reason: To walk in a way or in laws is to live by them day by day (18:3-4; Deuteronomy 8:6). The word "walk" runs through the whole chapter: if Israel walks in God's statutes, God will walk among them (verse 12); if they walk against him, he will walk against them (verses 21-28).

decisions.choice: if ... : the first of two conditions that frame the chapter
decisions.reason: The blessings of verses 4-13 depend on this "if"; verse 14 begins the opposite condition, "but if you do not listen". Deuteronomy 28 sets out blessings and curses in the same way.

decisions.choice: statutes, commandments (Balanced); laws, commands (Readable)
decisions.reason: The chapter names God's laws with three words, statutes, judgments and commandments (verses 15, 43, 46). Balanced keeps statutes and commandments and says "rulings" for judgments; Readable says laws, rules and commands.

decisions.choice: "Tuseme ..." ("let us say ...")
decisions.reason: Readable states each condition of the chapter as a short sentence of its own (verses 3, 14-15, 23, 27, 40-41); "Tuseme" is the ordinary spoken way to set up such a case. French "Supposons que" and Spanish "Supongamos que" do the same.

source.text: וְנָתַתִּ֥י גִשְׁמֵיכֶ֖ם בְּעִתָּ֑ם וְנָתְנָ֤ה הָאָ֨רֶץ֙ יְבוּלָ֔הּ וְעֵ֥ץ הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה יִתֵּ֥ן פִּרְיֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: and I will give your rains in their time, and will give the land its produce, and [the] tree of the field will give its fruit.

en.L: then I will give your rains in their season, and the land will give its produce, and the tree of the field will give its fruit.
en.B: then I will send you rain at the right season; the land will yield its crops, and the trees of the field their fruit.
en.R: Then I will send you rain at the right time. The land will grow crops, and the trees will produce fruit.

es.L: entonces {{plural_you:les|os}} daré {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} lluvias a su tiempo, y la tierra dará su producto, y el árbol del campo dará su fruto.
es.B: entonces {{plural_you:les|os}} enviaré la lluvia en su estación; la tierra dará sus cosechas, y los árboles del campo, su fruto.
es.R: Entonces {{plural_you:les|os}} enviaré la lluvia en el momento oportuno. La tierra producirá cosechas, y los árboles darán fruto.

fr.L: alors je vous donnerai vos pluies en leur saison, et la terre donnera son produit, et l’arbre des champs donnera son fruit.
fr.B: alors je vous enverrai la pluie en son temps ; la terre donnera ses récoltes, et les arbres des champs leurs fruits.
fr.R: Alors je vous enverrai la pluie au bon moment. La terre produira des récoltes, et les arbres donneront des fruits.

sw.L: basi nitawapa mvua zenu kwa majira yake, na nchi itatoa mazao yake, na mti wa shambani utatoa matunda yake.
sw.B: basi nitawanyeshea mvua kwa wakati wake; nchi itatoa mazao yake, na miti ya mashambani itazaa matunda yake.
sw.R: Basi nitawaletea mvua kwa wakati unaofaa. Nchi itatoa mazao, na miti itazaa matunda.

decisions.choice: your rains in their season: rain when the crops need it
decisions.reason: Farming in Canaan depended on rain at two seasons: the early rains of autumn that soften the ground for sowing and the late rains of spring that fill out the grain (Deuteronomy 11:14; Jeremiah 5:24). The promise is rain at the right times, not just much rain.

decisions.choice: I will give ... the land will give ... the tree will give: God gives through the land
decisions.reason: The same verb, "give", is used three times. The land's produce is God's gift. Verse 20 reverses each part: the land will not give its produce, nor the tree its fruit.

source.text: וְהִשִּׂ֨יג לָכֶ֥ם דַּ֨יִשׁ֙ אֶת־בָּצִ֔יר וּבָצִ֖יר יַשִּׂ֣יג אֶת־זָ֑רַע וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֤ם לַחְמְכֶם֙ לָשֹׂ֔בַע וִֽישַׁבְתֶּ֥ם לָבֶ֖טַח בְּאַרְצְכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And will reach for you threshing the grape harvest, and grape harvest will reach the sowing, and you will eat your bread to fullness, and you will dwell in security in your land.

en.L: And your threshing will reach to the grape harvest, and the grape harvest will reach to the sowing; and you will eat your bread to the full and dwell in security in your land.
en.B: Threshing will keep you busy until the grape harvest, and the grape harvest until it is time to sow. You will have bread enough to be satisfied, and you will live in your land secure.
en.R: You will have so much grain that you will still be threshing it when it is time to pick grapes. And you will still be picking grapes when it is time to plant seed again. You will have plenty to eat, and you will live safely in your land.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} trilla alcanzará a la vendimia, y la vendimia alcanzará a la siembra; y {{plural_you:comerán|comeréis}} {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} pan hasta la saciedad y {{plural_you:habitarán|habitaréis}} seguros en {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} tierra.
es.B: La trilla {{plural_you:los|os}} tendrá ocupados hasta la vendimia, y la vendimia hasta el tiempo de sembrar. {{plural_you:Comerán|Comeréis}} pan hasta quedar satisfechos, y {{plural_you:vivirán|viviréis}} seguros en {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} tierra.
es.R: {{plural_you:Tendrán|Tendréis}} tanto grano que todavía lo {{plural_you:estarán|estaréis}} trillando cuando llegue el tiempo de recoger la uva. Y todavía {{plural_you:estarán|estaréis}} recogiendo la uva cuando llegue el momento de sembrar otra vez. {{plural_you:Tendrán|Tendréis}} comida de sobra, y {{plural_you:vivirán|viviréis}} a salvo en {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} tierra.

fr.L: Et votre battage atteindra la vendange, et la vendange atteindra les semailles ; et vous mangerez votre pain à satiété, et vous habiterez en sécurité dans votre pays.
fr.B: Le battage du grain vous occupera jusqu’aux vendanges, et les vendanges jusqu’au temps des semailles. Vous aurez du pain à satiété, et vous vivrez en sécurité dans votre pays.
fr.R: Vous aurez tant de grain que vous serez encore en train de le battre quand viendra le moment de cueillir le raisin. Et vous serez encore en train de cueillir le raisin quand il faudra semer de nouveau. Vous aurez beaucoup à manger, et vous vivrez en sécurité dans votre pays.

sw.L: Na kupura kwenu kutafikia mavuno ya zabibu, na mavuno ya zabibu yatafikia upanzi; nanyi mtakula mkate wenu hata kushiba, na mtakaa salama katika nchi yenu.
sw.B: Kupura nafaka kutawashughulisha mpaka mavuno ya zabibu, na mavuno ya zabibu mpaka wakati wa kupanda. Mtakuwa na mkate wa kutosha kushiba, nanyi mtaishi salama katika nchi yenu.
sw.R: Mtakuwa na nafaka nyingi sana hata bado mtakuwa mnaipura wakati wa kuchuma zabibu utakapofika. Na bado mtakuwa mnachuma zabibu wakati wa kupanda mbegu tena utakapofika. Mtakuwa na chakula tele, nanyi mtaishi kwa usalama katika nchi yenu.

decisions.choice: threshing ... grape harvest ... sowing: harvests so large that one season runs into the next
decisions.reason: Grain was threshed in late spring and early summer, grapes were gathered in late summer, and seed was sown in autumn. The harvest will be so great that each task is still going on when the next is due (compare Amos 9:13).

decisions.choice: bread: food in general; in security: without fear of attack
decisions.reason: "Bread" stands for food. "In security" means living in safety, with no enemy to fear, as in 25:18-19, where the same promise is tied to keeping the sabbath years.

decisions.choice: so much grain ... still be threshing ... plant seed again
decisions.reason: Readable spells out the picture: the harvest is so large that the work of one season lasts into the next.

source.text: וְנָתַתִּ֤י שָׁלוֹם֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ וּשְׁכַבְתֶּ֖ם וְאֵ֣ין מַחֲרִ֑יד וְהִשְׁבַּתִּ֞י חַיָּ֤ה רָעָה֙ מִן־הָאָ֔רֶץ וְחֶ֖רֶב לֹא־תַעֲבֹ֥ר בְּאַרְצְכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will give peace in the land, and you will lie down and there [is] none making afraid, and I will make cease [the] evil beast from the land, and a sword not will pass through your land.

en.L: And I will give peace in the land, and you will lie down, and there [will be] no one making [you] afraid; and I will make harmful beasts cease from the land, and a sword will not pass through your land.
en.B: I will give peace in the land, and you will lie down to sleep with no one to frighten you. I will rid the land of harmful beasts, and no sword will cross your land.
en.R: I will bring peace to your land. You will go to sleep, and no one will scare you. I will remove dangerous wild animals from the land. No army will attack your country.

es.L: Y daré paz en la tierra, y {{plural_you:se acostarán|os acostaréis}} y no habrá quien {{plural_you:los|os}} espante; y haré desaparecer de la tierra las fieras dañinas, y la espada no pasará por {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} tierra.
es.B: Pondré paz en la tierra, y {{plural_you:se acostarán|os acostaréis}} a dormir sin que nadie {{plural_you:los|os}} asuste. Libraré la tierra de las fieras dañinas, y ninguna espada cruzará {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} país.
es.R: Traeré paz a {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} país. {{plural_you:Se irán|Os iréis}} a dormir, y nadie {{plural_you:los|os}} asustará. Quitaré de la tierra los animales salvajes peligrosos. Ningún ejército atacará {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} país.

fr.L: Et je donnerai la paix dans le pays, et vous vous coucherez, et il n’y aura personne pour [vous] faire peur ; et je ferai disparaître du pays les bêtes nuisibles, et l’épée ne passera pas par votre pays.
fr.B: Je mettrai la paix dans le pays : vous vous coucherez pour dormir sans que personne vous effraie. Je débarrasserai le pays des bêtes dangereuses, et aucune épée ne traversera votre pays.
fr.R: J’apporterai la paix dans votre pays. Vous irez dormir, et personne ne vous fera peur. J’enlèverai du pays les animaux sauvages dangereux. Aucune armée n’attaquera votre pays.

sw.L: Nami nitatoa amani katika nchi, nanyi mtalala, wala hapatakuwa na mtu wa [kuwatia] hofu; nami nitawakomesha wanyama wabaya katika nchi, wala upanga hautapita katika nchi yenu.
sw.B: Nitaleta amani katika nchi, nanyi mtalala usingizi bila mtu yeyote wa kuwatisha. Nitaiondolea nchi wanyama wakali, wala hakuna upanga utakaopita katika nchi yenu.
sw.R: Nitaleta amani katika nchi yenu. Mtalala, wala hakuna atakayewatisha. Nitawaondoa katika nchi wanyama wa porini walio hatari. Hakuna jeshi litakaloishambulia nchi yenu.

decisions.choice: peace: safety and well-being, with no war
decisions.reason: The word means wholeness and well-being, here above all freedom from attack, as the rest of the verse shows. To lie down with no one to frighten is a picture of safety (Job 11:19; Micah 4:4).

decisions.choice: harmful beasts: wild animals that kill people and flocks
decisions.reason: The word paired with "beast" means evil or harmful. Wild animals were a real danger in a thinly settled land (Exodus 23:29). Verse 22 turns the promise around.

decisions.choice: No army will attack
decisions.reason: The sword stands for war. Readable says what it means. Literal and Balanced keep "sword".

source.text: וּרְדַפְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־אֹיְבֵיכֶ֑ם וְנָפְל֥וּ לִפְנֵיכֶ֖ם לֶחָֽרֶב

records.literal_gloss: And you will pursue your enemies, and they will fall before you by the sword.

en.L: And you will pursue your enemies, and they will fall before you by the sword.
en.B: You will chase your enemies, and they will fall by the sword in front of you.
en.R: You will chase your enemies, and they will be killed in battle in front of you.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:perseguirán|perseguiréis}} a {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} enemigos, y caerán delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} a espada.
es.B: {{plural_you:Darán|Daréis}} caza a {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} enemigos, y caerán a filo de espada ante {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.R: {{plural_you:Perseguirán|Perseguiréis}} a {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} enemigos, y ellos morirán en la batalla delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.

fr.L: Et vous poursuivrez vos ennemis, et ils tomberont devant vous par l’épée.
fr.B: Vous pourchasserez vos ennemis, et ils tomberont sous l’épée devant vous.
fr.R: Vous courrez après vos ennemis, et ils seront tués au combat devant vous.

sw.L: Nanyi mtawafuatia adui zenu, nao wataanguka mbele yenu kwa upanga.
sw.B: Mtawafukuza adui zenu, nao wataanguka kwa upanga mbele yenu.
sw.R: Mtawakimbiza adui zenu, nao watauawa vitani mbele yenu.

decisions.choice: fall by the sword: be killed in battle
decisions.reason: The phrase means to die fighting. Here the enemies fall; in verse 36 it is Israel who will fall, with no one pursuing.

source.text: וְרָדְפ֨וּמִכֶּ֤ם חֲמִשָּׁה֙ מֵאָ֔ה וּמֵאָ֥ה מִכֶּ֖ם רְבָבָ֣ה יִרְדֹּ֑פוּ וְנָפְל֧וּ אֹיְבֵיכֶ֛ם לִפְנֵיכֶ֖ם לֶחָֽרֶב׃

records.literal_gloss: And will pursue of you five a hundred, and a hundred of you ten thousand will pursue, and will fall your enemies before you by the sword.

en.L: And five of you will pursue 100, and 100 of you will pursue 10,000, and your enemies will fall before you by the sword.
en.B: Five of you will put 100 to flight, and 100 of you will rout 10,000. Your enemies will fall before you by the sword.
en.R: Just five of you will chase away 100. And 100 of you will chase away 10,000. Your enemies will be killed in battle in front of you.

es.L: Y cinco de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} perseguirán a 100, y 100 de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} perseguirán a 10 000, y {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} enemigos caerán delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} a espada.
es.B: Cinco de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} pondrán en fuga a 100, y 100 de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} derrotarán a 10 000. {{plural_you:Sus|Vuestros}} enemigos caerán a filo de espada ante {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.R: Solo cinco de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} harán huir a 100. Y 100 de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} harán huir a 10 000. {{plural_you:Sus|Vuestros}} enemigos morirán en la batalla delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.

fr.L: Et cinq d’entre vous en poursuivront 100, et 100 d’entre vous en poursuivront 10 000, et vos ennemis tomberont devant vous par l’épée.
fr.B: Cinq d’entre vous en mettront 100 en fuite, et 100 d’entre vous en mettront 10 000 en déroute. Vos ennemis tomberont sous l’épée devant vous.
fr.R: Il suffira de cinq d’entre vous pour en faire fuir 100. Et 100 d’entre vous en feront fuir 10 000. Vos ennemis seront tués au combat devant vous.

sw.L: Na watano kati yenu watawafuatia 100, na 100 kati yenu watawafuatia 10,000, na adui zenu wataanguka mbele yenu kwa upanga.
sw.B: Watano kati yenu watawakimbiza 100, na 100 kati yenu watawashinda 10,000. Adui zenu wataanguka kwa upanga mbele yenu.
sw.R: Watu watano tu kati yenu watawafukuza 100. Na 100 kati yenu watawafukuza 10,000. Adui zenu watauawa vitani mbele yenu.

decisions.choice: five ... a hundred ... ten thousand: a few will defeat many
decisions.reason: The numbers are not a fixed ratio but a picture of God giving a small force victory over a great one (Deuteronomy 32:30; Joshua 23:10). In the curses the picture is reversed: Israel will flee when no one pursues (verse 17).

source.text: וּפָנִ֣יתִי אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם וְהִפְרֵיתִ֣י אֶתְכֶ֔ם וְהִרְבֵּיתִ֖י אֶתְכֶ֑ם וַהֲקִימֹתִ֥י אֶת־בְּרִיתִ֖י אִתְּכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will turn to you, and I will make fruitful you, and I will multiply you, and I will establish my covenant with you.

en.L: And I will turn to you and make you fruitful and multiply you, and I will establish {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant with you.
en.B: I will turn toward you with favor, make you fruitful and increase your numbers, and I will uphold {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant with you.
en.R: I will be kind to you. I will give you many children, and your numbers will grow. I will keep the promises of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant with you.

es.L: Y me volveré hacia {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, y {{plural_you:los|os}} haré fecundos y {{plural_you:los|os}} multiplicaré, y estableceré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.B: Me volveré hacia {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} con favor, {{plural_you:los|os}} haré fecundos y {{plural_you:los|os}} haré crecer en número, y mantendré firme {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.R: Seré bondadoso con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. {{plural_you:Les|Os}} daré muchos hijos, y {{plural_you:serán|seréis}} cada vez más. Cumpliré las promesas de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.

fr.L: Et je me tournerai vers vous, et je vous rendrai féconds et vous multiplierai, et j’établirai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} alliance avec vous.
fr.B: Je tournerai vers vous un regard favorable, je vous rendrai féconds et je vous ferai devenir nombreux, et je maintiendrai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} alliance avec vous.
fr.R: Je serai bon envers vous. Je vous donnerai beaucoup d’enfants, et vous deviendrez nombreux. Je tiendrai les promesses de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} alliance avec vous.

sw.L: Nami nitawageukia, na kuwafanya mzae, na kuwazidisha, nami nitalithibitisha agano {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} pamoja nanyi.
sw.B: Nitawaangalia kwa upendeleo, nitawafanya mzae na kuongezeka, nami nitalidumisha agano {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} nanyi.
sw.R: Nitawatendea mema. Nitawapa watoto wengi, nanyi mtaongezeka. Nitazitimiza ahadi za agano {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} nanyi.

decisions.choice: I will turn to you: I will look on you with favor
decisions.reason: To turn one's face toward someone is to give them attention and kindness (2 Kings 13:23; Psalm 25:16). It is the opposite of "I will set my face against you" (verse 17).

decisions.choice: make you fruitful and multiply you ... establish my covenant: the promises to Abraham kept
decisions.reason: The words echo God's first blessing on humankind (Genesis 1:28) and his promise to Abraham, "I will make you very fruitful ... and I will establish my covenant" (Genesis 17:6-7). "Establish" here means to keep a covenant in force and carry it out, not to make a new one.

decisions.choice: uphold (Balanced); keep the promises of (Readable)
decisions.reason: The verb means to make stand or confirm. Literal keeps "establish".

source.text: וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֥ם יָשָׁ֖ן נוֹשָׁ֑ן וְיָשָׁ֕ן מִפְּנֵ֥י חָדָ֖שׁ תּוֹצִֽיאוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will eat old, long stored, and the old because of [the] new you will bring out.

en.L: And you will eat old [grain], long stored, and the old you will bring out because of the new.
en.B: You will still be eating from last year's harvest, long stored, when you have to clear it out to make room for the new.
en.R: You will still be eating food from last year's harvest when the new harvest comes in. You will have to clear out the old food to make room for the new.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:comerán|comeréis}} [grano] añejo, guardado mucho tiempo, y {{plural_you:sacarán|sacaréis}} lo añejo a causa de lo nuevo.
es.B: Todavía {{plural_you:estarán|estaréis}} comiendo de la cosecha del año anterior, guardada largo tiempo, cuando {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} que sacarla para hacer sitio a la nueva.
es.R: Todavía {{plural_you:estarán|estaréis}} comiendo de la cosecha del año pasado cuando llegue la nueva cosecha. {{plural_you:Tendrán|Tendréis}} que sacar la comida vieja para hacer lugar a la nueva.

fr.L: Et vous mangerez du vieux [grain], longtemps gardé, et vous sortirez le vieux à cause du nouveau.
fr.B: Vous mangerez encore de la récolte de l’année précédente, longtemps gardée, quand il faudra la sortir pour faire place à la nouvelle.
fr.R: Vous mangerez encore la nourriture de la récolte de l’année d’avant quand la nouvelle récolte arrivera. Vous devrez vider vos réserves de l’ancienne nourriture pour faire de la place à la nouvelle.

sw.L: Nanyi mtakula [nafaka] ya zamani, iliyokaa muda mrefu, nanyi mtaitoa ile ya zamani kwa sababu ya ile mpya.
sw.B: Bado mtakuwa mnakula mavuno ya mwaka uliopita, yaliyohifadhiwa muda mrefu, wakati itakapowabidi kuyatoa ili kupata nafasi kwa mavuno mapya.
sw.R: Bado mtakuwa mnakula chakula cha mavuno ya mwaka uliopita wakati mavuno mapya yatakapoingia. Itawabidi kutoa chakula cha zamani ili kupata nafasi ya kuweka kipya.

decisions.choice: old, long stored ... bring out because of the new: so much food that the stores overflow
decisions.reason: Last year's harvest will last so long that it must be taken out of the storerooms to make space for the new crop. The same pair of words, old and new, is used of crops in 25:22.

decisions.choice: last year's harvest
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "old"; the context shows it is stored grain from an earlier harvest. Literal brackets "grain".

source.text: וְנָתַתִּ֥י מִשְׁכָּנִ֖י בְּתוֹכְכֶ֑ם וְלֹֽא־תִגְעַ֥ל נַפְשִׁ֖י אֶתְכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will put my dwelling place among you, and not will abhor my soul you.

en.L: And I will set {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} dwelling place among you, and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} soul will not abhor you.
en.B: I will set {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} dwelling place in your midst, and I will not turn from you in loathing.
en.R: I will make {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} home among you. I will not turn away from you in disgust.

es.L: Y pondré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} morada en medio de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, y {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} alma no {{plural_you:los|os}} aborrecerá.
es.B: Estableceré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} morada entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, y no me apartaré de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} con repugnancia.
es.R: Haré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} hogar entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. No {{plural_you:les|os}} daré la espalda con asco.

fr.L: Et je mettrai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} Demeure au milieu de vous, et {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} âme ne vous aura pas en horreur.
fr.B: J’établirai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} Demeure parmi vous, et je ne me détournerai pas de vous avec dégoût.
fr.R: Je ferai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} maison au milieu de vous. Je ne vous rejetterai pas avec dégoût.

sw.L: Nami nitaweka maskani {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} kati yenu, wala nafsi {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} haitawachukia.
sw.B: Nitaweka maskani {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} katikati yenu, wala sitawakataa kwa chukizo.
sw.R: Nitafanya makao {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} kati yenu. Sitawaacha kwa kuchukizwa nanyi.

decisions.choice: my dwelling place: the tabernacle, where God lives among his people
decisions.reason: The word is the one used for the tabernacle (Exodus 25:9; 26:1). God promised, "I will dwell among the Israelites" (Exodus 29:45). Here that presence is the height of the blessings, with verse 12.

decisions.choice: my soul will not abhor you: I myself will not reject you with loathing
decisions.reason: "My soul" means "I myself", with feeling. The verb means to loathe or cast off with disgust. The same verb is used of Israel in verse 15 ("if your soul abhors my judgments") and of God in verse 30, and verse 44 promises that even then he will not abhor them so as to destroy them.

decisions.choice: my dwelling place: the Hebrew text followed
alternatives: I will set my covenant among you
decisions.reason: The Greek translation (Septuagint) reads "my covenant" here instead of "my dwelling place". The Hebrew reading is followed; reviewers should check the Greek.

decisions.choice: "ma Demeure" (L, B); "ma maison" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is the one used for the tabernacle (m1), which French calls "la Demeure" at Literal and Balanced; the capital keeps that link. Readable says "my home" as the English does.

source.text: וְהִתְהַלַּכְתִּי֙ בְּת֣וֹכְכֶ֔ם וְהָיִ֥יתִי לָכֶ֖ם לֵֽאלֹהִ֑ים וְאַתֶּ֖ם תִּהְיוּ־לִ֥י לְעָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will walk about among you, and I will be for you God, and you will be for me a people.

en.L: And I will walk about among you, and I will be your God, and you will be {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people.
en.B: I will go about among you. I will be God to you, and you will be {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people.
en.R: I will walk among you. I will be your God, and you will be {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people.

es.L: Y me pasearé en medio de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, y seré {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Dios, y {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{plural_you:serán|seréis}} {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo.
es.B: Andaré entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Seré Dios para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, y {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{plural_you:serán|seréis}} {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo.
es.R: Caminaré entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Seré {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Dios, y {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{plural_you:serán|seréis}} {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo.

fr.L: Et j’irai et viendrai au milieu de vous, et je serai votre Dieu, et vous serez {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple.
fr.B: Je circulerai parmi vous. Je serai Dieu pour vous, et vous serez {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple.
fr.R: Je marcherai parmi vous. Je serai votre Dieu, et vous serez {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple.

sw.L: Nami nitatembea-tembea kati yenu, nami nitakuwa Mungu wenu, nanyi mtakuwa watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}.
sw.B: Nitatembea katikati yenu. Nitakuwa Mungu kwenu, nanyi mtakuwa watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}.
sw.R: Nitatembea pamoja nanyi. Nitakuwa Mungu wenu, nanyi mtakuwa watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}.

decisions.choice: I will walk about among you: God present with his people, as in Eden
decisions.reason: The same form of the verb is used of God walking in the garden (Genesis 3:8) and moving through Israel's camp (Deuteronomy 23:15). Paul quotes this verse, joined with Ezekiel 37:27, in 2 Corinthians 6:16: "I will live in them and walk among them."

decisions.choice: I will be your God, and you will be my people: the covenant in a sentence
decisions.reason: This pair of promises sums up the covenant (Exodus 6:7; Jeremiah 31:33; Ezekiel 36:28; Revelation 21:3). God binds himself to Israel and Israel belongs to him.

source.text: אֲנִ֞י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹצֵ֤אתִי אֶתְכֶם֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם מִֽהְיֹ֥ת לָהֶ֖ם עֲבָדִ֑ים וָאֶשְׁבֹּר֙ מֹטֹ֣ת עֻלְּכֶ֔ם וָאוֹלֵ֥ךְ אֶתְכֶ֖ם קֽוֹמְמִיּֽוּת׃פ

records.literal_gloss: I [am] Yahweh your God, who brought out you from [the] land of Egypt from being for them slaves, and I broke [the] bars of your yoke and I made walk you upright.

en.L: I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, who brought you out from the land of Egypt, from being slaves to them; and I broke the bars of your yoke and made you walk upright.
en.B: I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God. I brought you out of the land of Egypt, where you were their slaves. I snapped the crossbars of the yoke on your neck and made you walk upright.
en.R: I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God. I brought you out of Egypt, where you were slaves. You were like oxen bent under a heavy wooden yoke, but I broke it. Now you can walk standing tall.

es.L: Yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Dios, que {{plural_you:los|os}} saqué de la tierra de Egipto para que no {{plural_you:fueran|fuerais}} sus esclavos; y rompí las barras de {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} yugo y {{plural_you:los|os}} hice andar erguidos.
es.B: Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Dios. {{plural_you:Los|Os}} saqué de la tierra de Egipto, donde {{plural_you:eran|erais}} sus esclavos. Rompí las barras del yugo que {{plural_you:llevaban|llevabais}} al cuello y {{plural_you:los|os}} hice caminar con la cabeza en alto.
es.R: Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Dios. {{plural_you:Los|Os}} saqué de Egipto, donde {{plural_you:eran|erais}} esclavos. {{plural_you:Eran|Erais}} como bueyes doblados bajo un pesado yugo de madera, pero yo lo rompí. Ahora {{plural_you:pueden|podéis}} caminar con la frente en alto.

fr.L: Je [suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu, qui vous ai fait sortir du pays d’Égypte, pour que vous ne soyez plus leurs esclaves ; et j’ai brisé les barres de votre joug, et je vous ai fait marcher la tête droite.
fr.B: Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu. Je vous ai fait sortir du pays d’Égypte, où vous étiez leurs esclaves. J’ai rompu les barres du joug qui pesait sur votre cou, et je vous ai fait marcher la tête haute.
fr.R: Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu. Je vous ai fait sortir d’Égypte, où vous étiez esclaves. Vous étiez comme des bœufs courbés sous un lourd joug de bois, mais je l’ai brisé. Maintenant vous pouvez marcher debout, la tête haute.

sw.L: Mimi [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu, niliyewatoa katika nchi ya Misri, msiwe watumwa wao; nami nilivunja miti ya nira yenu, nikawafanya mwende mkiwa mmesimama wima.
sw.B: Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu. Niliwatoa katika nchi ya Misri, mlikokuwa watumwa wao. Nilivunja miti ya nira iliyokuwa shingoni mwenu, nikawawezesha kutembea mkiwa mmeinua vichwa.
sw.R: Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu. Niliwatoa Misri, mlikokuwa watumwa. Mlikuwa kama ng'ombe walioinamishwa chini ya nira nzito ya mti, lakini {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} niliivunja. Sasa mnaweza kutembea mkiwa mmesimama wima.

decisions.choice: the bars of your yoke: the wooden pieces that held an ox under its load
decisions.reason: A yoke was a wooden beam laid on the necks of oxen, held in place by bars or pegs. An animal under the yoke walks bent down; with the bars broken it can lift its head. Slavery in Egypt is pictured as such a yoke (compare Jeremiah 28:10-13; Ezekiel 34:27).

decisions.choice: upright: with head held high, free and unashamed
decisions.reason: The word occurs only here. It means standing up straight, the posture of free people rather than slaves bowed under a load.

decisions.choice: like oxen bent under a heavy wooden yoke
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture of the yoke.

decisions.choice: slaves
decisions.reason: "Slaves" at every level, as the style guide keeps it for Israel's slavery in Egypt, set against walking upright as free people (m2).

source.text: וְאִם־לֹ֥א תִשְׁמְע֖וּ לִ֑י וְלֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֔וּ אֵ֥ת כָּל־הַמִּצְוֺ֖ת הָאֵֽלֶּה׃

records.literal_gloss: And if not you will listen to me, and not you will do all the commandments the these,

en.L: But if you do not listen to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, and do not do all these commandments,
en.B: But if you will not listen to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and do not carry out all these commandments,
en.R: But suppose you do not listen to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. Suppose you do not obey all these commands.

es.L: Pero si no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:escuchan|escucháis}}, y no {{plural_you:ponen|ponéis}} por obra todos estos mandamientos,
es.B: Pero si no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:quieren|queréis}} escuchar y no {{plural_you:cumplen|cumplís}} todos estos mandamientos,
es.R: Pero supongamos que no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:escuchan|escucháis}}. Supongamos que no {{plural_you:obedecen|obedecéis}} todos estos mandamientos.

fr.L: Mais si vous ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}écoutez pas, et si vous ne pratiquez pas tous ces commandements,
fr.B: Mais si vous refusez de {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}écouter et ne mettez pas en pratique tous ces commandements,
fr.R: Mais supposons que vous ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}écoutiez pas. Supposons que vous n’obéissiez pas à tous ces commandements.

sw.L: Lakini msiponisikiliza, wala msipozitenda amri hizi zote,
sw.B: Lakini kama hamtanisikiliza, wala hamtazitekeleza amri hizi zote,
sw.R: Lakini tuseme hamnisikilizi. Tuseme hamzitii amri hizi zote.

decisions.choice: but if not: the second condition, which opens the curses
decisions.reason: Verses 14-39 describe what will follow if Israel will not listen. The warnings come in five rounds (verses 14-17, 18-20, 21-22, 23-26, 27-39), each harder than the last and each opened by a new "if".

decisions.choice: listen to me: heed and obey
decisions.reason: To listen to God is to obey him, as the next clause makes clear (Exodus 19:5).

source.text: וְאִם־בְּחֻקֹּתַ֣י תִּמְאָ֔סוּ וְאִ֥ם אֶת־מִשְׁפָּטַ֖י תִּגְעַ֣ל נַפְשְׁכֶ֑ם לְבִלְתִּ֤י עֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת־כָּל־מִצְוֺתַ֔י לְהַפְרְכֶ֖ם אֶת־בְּרִיתִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: and if my statutes you will reject, and if my judgments will abhor your soul, so as not to do all my commandments, so that you break my covenant,

en.L: and if you reject {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} statutes, and if your soul abhors {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} judgments, so as not to do all {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} commandments, so that you break {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant,
en.B: if you reject {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} statutes and loathe {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} rulings, so that you fail to keep all {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} commandments and so break {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant,
en.R: Suppose you turn away from {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} laws and hate {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} rules. Suppose you refuse to obey {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} commands and so break {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant.

es.L: y si {{plural_you:desechan|desecháis}} {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} estatutos, y si {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} alma aborrece {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} juicios, para no poner por obra todos {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} mandamientos, de modo que {{plural_you:quebrantan|quebrantáis}} {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto,
es.B: si {{plural_you:rechazan|rechazáis}} {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} estatutos y {{plural_you:detestan|detestáis}} {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} normas, de manera que no {{plural_you:cumplen|cumplís}} todos {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} mandamientos y así {{plural_you:rompen|rompéis}} {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto,
es.R: Supongamos que {{plural_you:se apartan|os apartáis}} de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} leyes y {{plural_you:odian|odiáis}} {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} normas. Supongamos que {{plural_you:se niegan|os negáis}} a obedecer {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} mandamientos y así {{plural_you:rompen|rompéis}} {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto.

fr.L: et si vous rejetez {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} prescriptions, et si votre âme a en horreur {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} jugements, au point de ne pas pratiquer tous {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} commandements, en sorte que vous rompez {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} alliance,
fr.B: si vous rejetez {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} prescriptions et prenez en dégoût {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} règles, si bien que vous ne gardez pas tous {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} commandements et rompez ainsi {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} alliance,
fr.R: Supposons que vous vous détourniez de {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} lois et que vous détestiez {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} règles. Supposons que vous refusiez d’obéir à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} commandements et que vous rompiez ainsi {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} alliance.

sw.L: na mkizikataa kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}, na nafsi zenu zikizichukia hukumu {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}, hata msizitende amri {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} zote, na hivyo kulivunja agano {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}},
sw.B: mkizikataa kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} na kuyachukia maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, hata mkashindwa kushika amri {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} zote na hivyo kulivunja agano {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}},
sw.R: Tuseme mnaziacha sheria {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} na kuyachukia maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}. Tuseme mnakataa kutii amri {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} na hivyo mnalivunja agano {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}.

decisions.choice: reject ... your soul abhors: refuse and turn away with disgust
decisions.reason: The two verbs describe a deliberate turning away, not a failure through weakness. "Your soul abhors" uses the same words as God's promise in verse 11, "my soul will not abhor you"; Israel would do to God's laws what God promised not to do to Israel.

decisions.choice: break my covenant: make it void
decisions.reason: To break a covenant is to make it void by not keeping its terms (Genesis 17:14; Deuteronomy 31:16). Verse 44 says God will not break it on his side.

decisions.choice: rulings (Balanced); rules (Readable)
decisions.reason: The word is "judgments", decisions of law. Literal keeps "judgments".

source.text: אַף־אֲנִ֞י אֶֽעֱשֶׂה־זֹּ֣את לָכֶ֗ם וְהִפְקַדְתִּ֨י עֲלֵיכֶ֤ם בֶּֽהָלָה֙ אֶת־הַשַּׁחֶ֣פֶת וְאֶת־הַקַּדַּ֔חַת מְכַלּ֥וֹת עֵינַ֖יִם וּמְדִיבֹ֣ת נָ֑פֶשׁ וּזְרַעְתֶּ֤ם לָרִיק֙ זַרְעֲכֶ֔ם וַאֲכָלֻ֖הוּ אֹיְבֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Also I will do this to you, and I will appoint over you sudden terror, the consumption and the fever, making fail [the] eyes and making pine away [the] soul; and you will sow for emptiness your seed, and will eat it your enemies.

en.L: I also will do this to you: I will appoint over you sudden terror, wasting disease and fever, wearing out the eyes and making the soul pine away; and you will sow your seed in vain, and your enemies will eat it.
en.B: then I too will do this to you: I will send panic upon you, with wasting disease and burning fever that wear out the eyes and wear down the spirit. You will sow your seed and gain nothing from it, for your enemies will eat the harvest.
en.R: Then this is what I will do to you. I will make you suddenly terrified. I will send diseases that make you waste away, and fevers that ruin your eyes and drain your life. You will plant seed, but it will do you no good, because your enemies will eat the crops.

es.L: también yo {{plural_you:les|os}} haré esto: pondré sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} terror repentino, consunción y fiebre, que consumen los ojos y hacen languidecer el alma; y {{plural_you:sembrarán|sembraréis}} en vano {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} semilla, y {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} enemigos se la comerán.
es.B: entonces yo también {{plural_you:les|os}} haré esto: enviaré sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} el pánico, con enfermedades que consumen y fiebre ardiente, que agotan los ojos y abaten el ánimo. {{plural_you:Sembrarán|Sembraréis}} {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} semilla sin provecho, porque {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} enemigos se comerán la cosecha.
es.R: Entonces esto es lo que {{plural_you:les|os}} haré. {{plural_you:Los|Os}} llenaré de terror de repente. Enviaré enfermedades que {{plural_you:los|os}} harán consumirse, y fiebres que {{plural_you:les|os}} arruinarán los ojos y {{plural_you:les|os}} quitarán las fuerzas. {{plural_you:Sembrarán|Sembraréis}}, pero no {{plural_you:les|os}} servirá de nada, porque {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} enemigos se comerán las cosechas.

fr.L: alors {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} aussi, je vous ferai ceci : je placerai sur vous la terreur soudaine, la consomption et la fièvre, qui usent les yeux et font languir l’âme ; et vous sèmerez votre semence en vain, et vos ennemis la mangeront.
fr.B: alors {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} aussi, voici ce que je vous ferai : j’enverrai sur vous l’épouvante, avec la maladie qui consume et la fièvre brûlante, qui épuisent les yeux et abattent l’esprit. Vous sèmerez votre semence sans rien en tirer, car vos ennemis en mangeront la récolte.
fr.R: Alors voici ce que je vous ferai. Je vous remplirai soudain de terreur. J’enverrai des maladies qui vous feront dépérir, et des fièvres qui abîmeront vos yeux et vous videront de vos forces. Vous sèmerez, mais cela ne vous servira à rien, car vos ennemis mangeront les récoltes.

sw.L: {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} pia nitawatendea hivi: nitaweka juu yenu hofu ya ghafula, ugonjwa wa kukondesha na homa, vinavyofifisha macho na kuidhoofisha nafsi; nanyi mtapanda mbegu zenu bure, na adui zenu watazila.
sw.B: basi {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitawatendea hivi: nitawaletea hofu kuu, pamoja na ugonjwa wa kukondesha na homa kali, vitakavyochosha macho na kuvunja moyo. Mtapanda mbegu zenu bila faida, kwa maana adui zenu watakula mavuno.
sw.R: Basi hivi ndivyo nitakavyowatendea. Nitawatia hofu ya ghafula. Nitawaletea magonjwa yatakayowakondesha, na homa zitakazoharibu macho yenu na kuwamaliza nguvu. Mtapanda mbegu, lakini hamtafaidika kitu, kwa sababu adui zenu watakula mazao.

decisions.choice: sudden terror, wasting disease, fever
decisions.reason: The first word means sudden dread or panic. The two diseases are named again only in Deuteronomy 28:22: one makes the body waste away, the other is a burning fever. Their exact identity is not known.

decisions.choice: wearing out the eyes and making the soul pine away: sickness that drains sight and life
decisions.reason: Eyes that fail are a sign of weakness, grief or longing (Deuteronomy 28:65; Psalm 69:4). "Soul" here means life or vitality. The diseases leave the sick worn out in body and spirit.

decisions.choice: I also will do this ... sow in vain: God answers Israel's breach
decisions.reason: "I also" sets God's action against Israel's in verse 15. Sowing for others to reap is a covenant curse (Deuteronomy 28:33; Micah 6:15).

source.text: וְנָתַתִּ֤י פָנַי֙ בָּכֶ֔ם וְנִגַּפְתֶּ֖ם לִפְנֵ֣י אֹיְבֵיכֶ֑ם וְרָד֤וּ בָכֶם֙ שֹֽׂנְאֵיכֶ֔ם וְנַסְתֶּ֖ם וְאֵין־רֹדֵ֥ף אֶתְכֶֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And I will set my face against you, and you will be struck down before your enemies, and will rule over you those hating you, and you will flee and there [is] none pursuing you.

en.L: And I will set {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} face against you, and you will be struck down before your enemies, and those who hate you will rule over you, and you will flee when no one pursues you.
en.B: I will turn {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} face against you, and you will go down in defeat before your enemies. Your foes will rule you, and you will run when there is no one chasing you.
en.R: I will turn against you. Your enemies will defeat you. People who hate you will rule over you. You will be so afraid that you will run away even when no one is chasing you.

es.L: Y pondré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} rostro contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, y {{plural_you:serán|seréis}} heridos delante de {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} enemigos; los que {{plural_you:los|os}} aborrecen dominarán sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, y {{plural_you:huirán|huiréis}} sin que nadie {{plural_you:los|os}} persiga.
es.B: Volveré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} rostro contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, y {{plural_you:serán|seréis}} derrotados ante {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} enemigos. {{plural_you:Sus|Vuestros}} adversarios {{plural_you:los|os}} gobernarán, y {{plural_you:huirán|huiréis}} cuando nadie {{plural_you:los|os}} persiga.
es.R: Me pondré en contra de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. {{plural_you:Sus|Vuestros}} enemigos {{plural_you:los|os}} vencerán. Gente que {{plural_you:los|os}} odia {{plural_you:los|os}} gobernará. {{plural_you:Tendrán|Tendréis}} tanto miedo que {{plural_you:huirán|huiréis}} aunque nadie {{plural_you:los|os}} persiga.

fr.L: Et je tournerai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} face contre vous, et vous serez battus devant vos ennemis ; ceux qui vous haïssent domineront sur vous, et vous fuirez sans que personne vous poursuive.
fr.B: Je tournerai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} visage contre vous, et vous serez mis en déroute devant vos ennemis. Vos adversaires vous domineront, et vous fuirez alors que personne ne vous poursuit.
fr.R: Je me tournerai contre vous. Vos ennemis vous vaincront. Des gens qui vous haïssent vous gouverneront. Vous aurez si peur que vous fuirez même quand personne ne vous poursuivra.

sw.L: Nami nitauelekeza uso {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} dhidi yenu, nanyi mtapigwa mbele ya adui zenu; wale wanaowachukia watawatawala, nanyi mtakimbia wakati hakuna anayewafuatia.
sw.B: Nitaugeuza uso {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} dhidi yenu, nanyi mtashindwa mbele ya adui zenu. Watesi wenu watawatawala, nanyi mtakimbia hata pasipo mtu anayewafukuza.
sw.R: Nitakuwa kinyume chenu. Adui zenu watawashinda. Watu wanaowachukia watawatawala. Mtaogopa sana hata mtakimbia wakati hakuna mtu anayewafukuza.

decisions.choice: set my face against you: turn against you in judgment
decisions.reason: The phrase is used of God's settled opposition to someone (17:10; 20:3, 6). It is the reverse of "I will turn to you" in verse 9.

decisions.choice: you will flee when no one pursues: the blessing of verse 8 reversed
decisions.reason: Instead of a few chasing many, Israel will run from enemies who are not even there (verse 36; Proverbs 28:1).

decisions.choice: so afraid that
decisions.reason: Readable gives the reason for running when no one chases, which the verse implies.

source.text: וְאִ֨ם־עַד־אֵ֔לֶּה לֹ֥א תִשְׁמְע֖וּ לִ֑י וְיָסַפְתִּי֙ לְיַסְּרָ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֔ם שֶׁ֖בַע עַל־חַטֹּאתֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And if up to these not you will listen to me, and I will add to discipline you sevenfold for your sins.

en.L: And if even after these [things] you do not listen to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, then I will go on to discipline you seven [times] for your sins.
en.B: If even after these things you do not listen to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, I will go on to discipline you seven times more for your sins.
en.R: If you still do not listen to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} after all this, I will discipline you seven times more for your sins.

es.L: Y si aun después de estas [cosas] no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:escuchan|escucháis}}, volveré a {{plural_you:corregirlos|corregiros}} siete [veces] por {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} pecados.
es.B: Si aun después de esto no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:escuchan|escucháis}}, seguiré {{plural_you:corrigiéndolos|corrigiéndoos}} siete veces más por {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} pecados.
es.R: Si después de todo esto todavía no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:escuchan|escucháis}}, {{plural_you:los|os}} corregiré siete veces más por {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} pecados.

fr.L: Et si, même après ces [choses], vous ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}écoutez pas, je continuerai à vous corriger sept [fois] pour vos péchés.
fr.B: Si, même après cela, vous ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}écoutez pas, je continuerai à vous corriger, sept fois plus, à cause de vos péchés.
fr.R: Si, après tout cela, vous ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}écoutez toujours pas, je vous corrigerai sept fois plus pour vos péchés.

sw.L: Na kama hata baada ya [mambo] haya hamtanisikiliza, basi nitaendelea kuwaadibisha mara saba kwa ajili ya dhambi zenu.
sw.B: Kama hata baada ya mambo haya hamtanisikiliza, nitaendelea kuwaadibisha mara saba zaidi kwa sababu ya dhambi zenu.
sw.R: Kama bado hamtanisikiliza baada ya hayo yote, nitawaadibisha mara saba zaidi kwa ajili ya dhambi zenu.

decisions.choice: seven times: in full measure
decisions.reason: Seven is the number of fullness. "Sevenfold" means a punishment complete and much greater (Genesis 4:15; Psalm 79:12; Proverbs 24:16), not an exact multiple. The phrase returns in verses 21, 24 and 28 as each round of warning grows heavier.

decisions.choice: discipline: correct, train by punishment
decisions.reason: The verb means to discipline as a father disciplines a son (Deuteronomy 8:5; Proverbs 19:18). Its aim is to bring Israel back, as verse 23 shows ("if you are not disciplined by me").

decisions.choice: seven times more
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has the single word "sevenfold". Literal brackets "times".

decisions.choice: "corriger"
decisions.reason: The verb is a father's discipline that aims to bring Israel back (m2); "corriger" keeps that aim, where "punir" would say only the penalty and "châtier" sounds old. Used again in verses 23 and 28.

decisions.choice: "kuwaadibisha"
decisions.reason: "Kuadibisha" is to discipline and train, as a parent does, which is the sense of the verb (m2); "kuadhibu" would mean only to punish. Spanish says "corregir" for the same reason.

source.text: וְשָׁבַרְתִּ֖י אֶת־גְּא֣וֹן עֻזְּכֶ֑ם וְנָתַתִּ֤י אֶת־שְׁמֵיכֶם֙ כַּבַּרְזֶ֔ל וְאֶֽת־אַרְצְכֶ֖ם כַּנְּחֻשָֽׁה׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will break the pride of your strength, and I will make your heavens like iron and your land like bronze.

en.L: And I will break the pride of your strength, and I will make your heavens like iron and your land like bronze.
en.B: I will break the strength you are proud of. I will make your sky hard as iron and your soil hard as bronze.
en.R: I will break the power you are so proud of. The sky will give you no rain; it will be like iron. The ground will be as hard as bronze.

es.L: Y quebrantaré la soberbia de {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} fuerza, y haré {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} cielo como hierro y {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} tierra como bronce.
es.B: Quebraré la fuerza de la que {{plural_you:se enorgullecen|os enorgullecéis}}. Haré {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} cielo duro como el hierro y {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} suelo duro como el bronce.
es.R: Destruiré el poder del que tanto {{plural_you:se enorgullecen|os enorgullecéis}}. El cielo no {{plural_you:les|os}} dará lluvia; será como de hierro. La tierra estará tan dura como el bronce.

fr.L: Et je briserai l’orgueil de votre force, et je rendrai votre ciel comme le fer et votre terre comme le bronze.
fr.B: Je briserai la force dont vous êtes fiers. Je rendrai votre ciel dur comme le fer et votre sol dur comme le bronze.
fr.R: Je briserai la puissance dont vous êtes si fiers. Le ciel ne vous donnera plus de pluie ; il sera comme du fer. La terre sera aussi dure que du bronze.

sw.L: Nami nitakivunja kiburi cha nguvu zenu, nami nitazifanya mbingu zenu kama chuma na nchi yenu kama shaba.
sw.B: Nitazivunja nguvu mnazojivunia. Nitaifanya anga yenu kuwa ngumu kama chuma na ardhi yenu kuwa ngumu kama shaba.
sw.R: Nitaivunja nguvu mnayoijivunia sana. Mbingu hazitawapa mvua; zitakuwa kama chuma. Ardhi itakuwa ngumu kama shaba.

decisions.choice: the pride of your strength: the power Israel trusted in
decisions.reason: The phrase means the strength in which a people takes pride and puts its confidence (Ezekiel 24:21; 30:6). God will break whatever Israel relies on instead of him.

decisions.choice: heavens like iron and land like bronze: no rain, and ground too hard to farm
decisions.reason: A sky of metal gives no rain, and earth like metal cannot be plowed or grow anything. Deuteronomy 28:23 uses the same picture with the metals the other way round. It reverses the promise of rain in verse 4.

decisions.choice: give you no rain
decisions.reason: Readable explains what a sky like iron means.

source.text: וְתַ֥ם לָרִ֖יק כֹּחֲכֶ֑ם וְלֹֽא־תִתֵּ֤ן אַרְצְכֶם֙ אֶת־יְבוּלָ֔הּ וְעֵ֣ץ הָאָ֔רֶץ לֹ֥א יִתֵּ֖ן פִּרְיֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And will be spent for emptiness your strength, and not will give your land its produce, and [the] tree of the land not will give its fruit.

en.L: And your strength will be spent in vain, and your land will not give its produce, and the tree of the land will not give its fruit.
en.B: You will wear yourselves out for nothing. Your land will not give its crops, and the trees in the land will not give their fruit.
en.R: All your hard work will be wasted. Your land will grow no crops, and the trees will grow no fruit.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} fuerza se gastará en vano, y {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} tierra no dará su producto, y el árbol de la tierra no dará su fruto.
es.B: {{plural_you:Se agotarán|Os agotaréis}} para nada. {{plural_you:Su|Vuestra}} tierra no dará sus cosechas, y los árboles del país no darán su fruto.
es.R: Todo {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} trabajo será en vano. {{plural_you:Su|Vuestra}} tierra no producirá cosechas, y los árboles no darán fruto.

fr.L: Et votre force s’épuisera en vain, et votre terre ne donnera pas son produit, et l’arbre du pays ne donnera pas son fruit.
fr.B: Vous vous épuiserez pour rien. Votre terre ne donnera pas ses récoltes, et les arbres du pays ne donneront pas leurs fruits.
fr.R: Tout votre travail ne servira à rien. Votre terre ne produira pas de récoltes, et les arbres ne donneront pas de fruits.

sw.L: Na nguvu zenu zitatumika bure, na nchi yenu haitatoa mazao yake, na mti wa nchi hautatoa matunda yake.
sw.B: Mtajichosha bure. Nchi yenu haitatoa mazao yake, na miti ya nchi haitazaa matunda yake.
sw.R: Kazi yenu yote ngumu itakuwa bure. Nchi yenu haitatoa mazao, na miti haitazaa matunda.

decisions.choice: your strength spent in vain ... not give its produce: verse 4 reversed
decisions.reason: "Strength" here is the labor of farming. The words of verse 4 return with "not": the land will not give its produce, nor the tree its fruit.

source.text: וְאִם־תֵּֽלְכ֤וּ עִמִּי֙ קֶ֔רִי וְלֹ֥א תֹאב֖וּ לִשְׁמֹ֣עַֽ לִ֑י וְיָסַפְתִּ֤י עֲלֵיכֶם֙ מַכָּ֔ה שֶׁ֖בַע כְּחַטֹּאתֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And if you will walk with me contrariness, and not you will be willing to listen to me, and I will add to you a blow sevenfold according to your sins.

en.L: And if you walk with {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} in opposition and are not willing to listen to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, then I will add to you a blow seven [times] according to your sins.
en.B: If you keep walking in opposition to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and refuse to listen to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, I will strike you with blows seven times more, as your sins deserve.
en.R: If you keep going against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and refuse to listen to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, I will send seven times more disasters on you, because of your sins.

es.L: Y si {{plural_you:andan|andáis}} conmigo en oposición y no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:quieren|queréis}} escuchar, {{plural_you:les|os}} añadiré golpes siete [veces] conforme a {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} pecados.
es.B: Si {{plural_you:siguen|seguís}} andando en oposición a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} y no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:quieren|queréis}} escuchar, {{plural_you:los|os}} heriré con golpes siete veces más, como {{plural_you:merecen|merecéis}} por {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} pecados.
es.R: Si {{plural_you:siguen|seguís}} yendo en contra de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} y no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:quieren|queréis}} escuchar, {{plural_you:les|os}} enviaré siete veces más desgracias por {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} pecados.

fr.L: Et si vous marchez avec {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} en opposition et ne voulez pas {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}écouter, je vous ajouterai des coups sept [fois] selon vos péchés.
fr.B: Si vous continuez à marcher en opposition avec {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} et refusez de {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}écouter, je vous frapperai de coups sept fois plus nombreux, comme vos péchés le méritent.
fr.R: Si vous continuez à vous opposer à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} et refusez de {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}écouter, je vous enverrai sept fois plus de malheurs, à cause de vos péchés.

sw.L: Na mkienda pamoja {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} kwa upinzani, wala hamtaki kunisikiliza, basi nitawaongezea mapigo mara saba kulingana na dhambi zenu.
sw.B: Mkiendelea kwenda kinyume {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} na kukataa kunisikiliza, nitawapiga kwa mapigo mara saba zaidi, kama dhambi zenu zinavyostahili.
sw.R: Mkiendelea kunipinga na kukataa kunisikiliza, nitawaletea misiba mara saba zaidi kwa sababu ya dhambi zenu.

decisions.choice: in opposition: in hostility, going against someone
decisions.reason: The word occurs only in this chapter (verses 21, 23, 24, 27, 28, 40, 41). It comes from a root meaning to meet or encounter, and is usually taken as meeting someone head on, in hostility. Some take it to mean walking carelessly, as if by chance, treating God's will as of no account. Either way, Israel's way of walking with God is answered by God's way of walking with Israel (verse 24).

decisions.choice: a blow: a stroke or plague sent as punishment
decisions.reason: The word means a blow or wound, often a plague sent by God (Deuteronomy 28:59). On "seven times", see verse 18.

decisions.choice: "andar conmigo en oposición" (L), "andar en oposición a mí" (B), "ir en contra de mí" (R)
decisions.reason: The rare word is read as hostile opposition (m1). The same wording returns for God's answer in verses 24, 28 and 41, so the reader sees that God meets Israel's way with his own.

decisions.choice: "marcher avec moi en opposition" (L), "marcher en opposition avec moi" (B), "vous opposer à moi" (R)
decisions.reason: The rare word is read as hostile opposition (m1). Literal keeps the Hebrew order with "walk"; Balanced uses the French idiom "en opposition avec"; Readable drops the walking picture. The same wording is used for God's answer in verses 24, 28 and 41.

decisions.choice: "kwenda pamoja nami kwa upinzani" (L), "kwenda kinyume nami" (B), "kunipinga" (R)
decisions.reason: The rare word is read as hostile opposition (m1). Balanced uses the common idiom "kwenda kinyume na" (go against); the same wording returns for God's answer in verses 24, 28 and 41.

source.text: וְהִשְׁלַחְתִּ֨י בָכֶ֜ם אֶת־חַיַּ֤ת הַשָּׂדֶה֙ וְשִׁכְּלָ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֔ם וְהִכְרִ֨יתָה֙ אֶת־בְּהֶמְתְּכֶ֔ם וְהִמְעִ֖יטָה אֶתְכֶ֑ם וְנָשַׁ֖מּוּ דַּרְכֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will send among you the beast of the field, and it will make childless you and will cut off your livestock and will make few you, and will be desolate your roads.

en.L: And I will send among you the beasts of the field, and they will bereave you and cut off your livestock and make you few, and your roads will be desolate.
en.B: I will send the wild animals among you. They will take your children from you, wipe out your herds, and leave you so few that no one travels your roads.
en.R: I will send wild animals among you. They will kill your children and your animals. So few of you will be left that your roads will be empty.

es.L: Y enviaré entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} las fieras del campo, que {{plural_you:los|os}} dejarán sin hijos, y destruirán {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} ganado, y {{plural_you:los|os}} reducirán en número, y {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} caminos quedarán desolados.
es.B: Enviaré contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} los animales salvajes. {{plural_you:Les|Os}} arrebatarán a {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} hijos, acabarán con {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} rebaños y {{plural_you:los|os}} reducirán a tan pocos que nadie transitará por {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} caminos.
es.R: Enviaré animales salvajes entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Matarán a {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} hijos y a {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} animales. Quedarán tan pocos de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} que {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} caminos estarán vacíos.

fr.L: Et j’enverrai parmi vous les bêtes des champs, et elles vous priveront d’enfants, et elles extermineront votre bétail, et elles vous réduiront à un petit nombre, et vos chemins seront déserts.
fr.B: J’enverrai contre vous les bêtes sauvages. Elles vous enlèveront vos enfants, anéantiront vos troupeaux et vous rendront si peu nombreux que plus personne ne passera sur vos routes.
fr.R: J’enverrai des animaux sauvages au milieu de vous. Ils tueront vos enfants et vos bêtes. Il restera si peu de gens que vos routes seront vides.

sw.L: Nami nitatuma kati yenu wanyama wa porini, nao watawafiwisha, na kuwakatilia mbali wanyama wenu wa kufugwa, na kuwapunguza, na njia zenu zitakuwa ukiwa.
sw.B: Nitawapelekea wanyama wakali. Watawanyang'anya watoto wenu, wataangamiza mifugo yenu, na kuwapunguza sana hata hakuna mtu atakayepita katika njia zenu.
sw.R: Nitatuma wanyama wa porini kati yenu. Watawaua watoto wenu na mifugo yenu. Mtabaki wachache sana hata njia zenu zitakuwa tupu.

decisions.choice: bereave you: rob you of your children
decisions.reason: The verb means to make childless, to take away a parent's children (Genesis 43:14; Deuteronomy 32:25). Verse 6 promised that harmful beasts would cease; now they are sent.

decisions.choice: your roads will be desolate: no one left to travel them
decisions.reason: Empty roads are a sign of a land emptied of people and afraid to move about (Judges 5:6; Isaiah 33:8).

decisions.choice: take your children from you (Balanced); kill your children (Readable)
decisions.reason: The single verb "bereave" is spelled out. Literal keeps "bereave you".

source.text: וְאִ֨ם־בְּאֵ֔לֶּה לֹ֥א תִוָּסְר֖וּ לִ֑י וַהֲלַכְתֶּ֥ם עִמִּ֖י קֶֽרִי׃

records.literal_gloss: And if by these not you will let yourselves be disciplined by me, and you will walk with me contrariness,

en.L: And if by these [things] you are not disciplined by {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, and you walk with {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} in opposition,
en.B: If you will not accept {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} discipline even through these things, and you keep walking in opposition to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}},
en.R: Suppose even these troubles do not teach you to turn back to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, and you keep going against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.

es.L: Y si con estas [cosas] no {{plural_you:se dejan|os dejáis}} corregir por {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, sino que {{plural_you:andan|andáis}} conmigo en oposición,
es.B: Si ni aun con estas cosas {{plural_you:aceptan|aceptáis}} {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} corrección, y {{plural_you:siguen|seguís}} andando en oposición a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}},
es.R: Supongamos que ni siquiera estos males {{plural_you:les|os}} enseñan a volver a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, y que {{plural_you:siguen|seguís}} yendo en contra de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}.

fr.L: Et si par ces [choses] vous ne vous laissez pas corriger par {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, et si vous marchez avec {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} en opposition,
fr.B: Si, même par ces épreuves, vous n’acceptez pas {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} correction, et si vous continuez à marcher en opposition avec {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}},
fr.R: Supposons que même ces malheurs ne vous apprennent pas à revenir à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, et que vous continuiez à vous opposer à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.

sw.L: Na kama kwa [mambo] haya hamtakubali kuadibishwa na {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, bali mkaenda pamoja {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} kwa upinzani,
sw.B: Kama hata kwa mambo haya hamtakubali kuadibishwa na {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, na mkaendelea kwenda kinyume {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}},
sw.R: Tuseme hata taabu hizi haziwafundishi kunirudia, nanyi mnaendelea kunipinga.

decisions.choice: you are not disciplined by me: you will not let me correct you
decisions.reason: The verb form means to let oneself be disciplined, to accept correction (Jeremiah 6:8; 31:18). The purpose of the earlier blows was to correct Israel (verse 18).

decisions.choice: teach you to turn back to me
decisions.reason: Readable states what accepting God's correction would mean.

source.text: וְהָלַכְתִּ֧י אַף־אֲנִ֛י עִמָּכֶ֖ם בְּקֶ֑רִי וְהִכֵּיתִ֤י אֶתְכֶם֙ גַּם־אָ֔נִי שֶׁ֖בַע עַל־חַטֹּאתֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: and I will walk also I with you in contrariness, and I will strike you also I sevenfold for your sins.

en.L: then I also will walk with you in opposition, and I, even I, will strike you seven [times] for your sins.
en.B: then I too will walk in opposition to you, and it is I who will strike you seven times over for your sins.
en.R: Then I will go against you too. I will strike you seven times more for your sins.

es.L: entonces también yo andaré con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} en oposición, y yo, sí, yo {{plural_you:los|os}} heriré siete [veces] por {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} pecados.
es.B: entonces yo también andaré en oposición a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, y seré yo quien {{plural_you:los|os}} hiera siete veces más por {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} pecados.
es.R: Entonces yo también iré en contra de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. {{plural_you:Los|Os}} heriré siete veces más por {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} pecados.

fr.L: alors {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} aussi je marcherai avec vous en opposition, et {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, oui {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, je vous frapperai sept [fois] pour vos péchés.
fr.B: alors {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} aussi je marcherai en opposition avec vous, et c’est {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} qui vous frapperai sept fois plus pour vos péchés.
fr.R: Alors {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} aussi, je m’opposerai à vous. Je vous frapperai sept fois plus pour vos péchés.

sw.L: basi {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} pia nitakwenda pamoja nanyi kwa upinzani, na {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, naam {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, nitawapiga mara saba kwa ajili ya dhambi zenu.
sw.B: basi {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} pia nitakwenda kinyume nanyi, na {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} mwenyewe nitawapiga mara saba zaidi kwa ajili ya dhambi zenu.
sw.R: Basi {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitawapinga. Nitawapiga mara saba zaidi kwa ajili ya dhambi zenu.

decisions.choice: I also ... also I: God answers like with like
decisions.reason: The word "I" is stressed twice. Israel's opposition is met by God's own; the punishment fits the way they have chosen to walk (compare Psalm 18:27).

source.text: וְהֵבֵאתִ֨י עֲלֵיכֶ֜ם חֶ֗רֶב נֹקֶ֨מֶת֙ נְקַם־בְּרִ֔ית וְנֶאֱסַפְתֶּ֖ם אֶל־עָרֵיכֶ֑ם וְשִׁלַּ֤חְתִּי דֶ֨בֶר֙ בְּת֣וֹכְכֶ֔ם וְנִתַּתֶּ֖ם בְּיַד־אוֹיֵֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will bring on you a sword avenging [the] vengeance of covenant, and you will gather into your cities, and I will send pestilence among you, and you will be given into [the] hand of enemy.

en.L: And I will bring upon you a sword avenging the vengeance of the covenant, and you will gather into your cities, and I will send pestilence among you, and you will be given into the hand of the enemy.
en.B: I will bring a sword against you that will carry out the vengeance of the covenant. When you crowd into your cities for safety, I will send deadly disease among you, and you will be handed over to your enemy.
en.R: I will send armies to attack you, to punish you for breaking the covenant. You will run into your cities to be safe, but I will send deadly diseases among you. Then your enemies will capture you.

es.L: Y traeré sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} espada que ejecute la venganza del pacto, y {{plural_you:se reunirán|os reuniréis}} en {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} ciudades, y enviaré peste entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, y {{plural_you:serán|seréis}} entregados en mano del enemigo.
es.B: Traeré contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} la espada, que llevará a cabo la venganza del pacto. Cuando {{plural_you:se amontonen|os amontonéis}} en {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} ciudades en busca de refugio, enviaré entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} una enfermedad mortal, y {{plural_you:serán|seréis}} entregados a {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} enemigo.
es.R: Enviaré ejércitos para que {{plural_you:los|os}} ataquen, como castigo por haber roto el pacto. {{plural_you:Correrán|Correréis}} a {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} ciudades para estar a salvo, pero enviaré entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} enfermedades mortales. Entonces {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} enemigos {{plural_you:los|os}} capturarán.

fr.L: Et je ferai venir sur vous une épée qui exercera la vengeance de l’alliance, et vous vous rassemblerez dans vos villes, et j’enverrai la peste au milieu de vous, et vous serez livrés aux mains de l’ennemi.
fr.B: Je ferai venir contre vous l’épée, qui exécutera la vengeance de l’alliance. Quand vous vous entasserez dans vos villes pour vous mettre à l’abri, j’enverrai parmi vous une maladie mortelle, et vous serez livrés à votre ennemi.
fr.R: J’enverrai des armées vous attaquer, pour vous punir d’avoir rompu l’alliance. Vous courrez dans vos villes pour être en sécurité, mais j’enverrai parmi vous des maladies mortelles. Alors vos ennemis vous captureront.

sw.L: Nami nitaleta juu yenu upanga utakaolipiza kisasi cha agano, nanyi mtakusanyika ndani ya miji yenu, nami nitatuma tauni kati yenu, nanyi mtatiwa mkononi mwa adui.
sw.B: Nitaleta dhidi yenu upanga utakaotekeleza kisasi cha agano. Mtakapojazana katika miji yenu ili kujihifadhi, nitatuma ugonjwa wa kuua kati yenu, nanyi mtatiwa mikononi mwa adui yenu.
sw.R: Nitatuma majeshi kuwashambulia, ili kuwaadhibu kwa kulivunja agano. Mtakimbilia miji yenu ili mwe salama, lakini nitatuma magonjwa ya kuua kati yenu. Kisha adui zenu watawakamata.

decisions.choice: a sword avenging the vengeance of the covenant: war that carries out the covenant's penalty
decisions.reason: Vengeance here is the just penalty a covenant lays on those who break it. The sword is war, the enemies God will bring (Deuteronomy 32:41-43).

decisions.choice: gather into your cities ... pestilence: the sufferings of a siege
decisions.reason: When an army invaded, people fled into walled cities. Crowded together and short of food and water, they were struck by disease, and the city fell (Jeremiah 14:12; Ezekiel 5:12).

decisions.choice: armies
decisions.reason: Readable says what the sword stands for, as in verse 6.

source.text: בְּשִׁבְרִ֣י לָכֶם֮ מַטֵּה־לֶחֶם֒ וְ֠אָפוּ עֶ֣שֶׂר נָשִׁ֤ים לַחְמְכֶם֙ בְּתַנּ֣וּר אֶחָ֔ד וְהֵשִׁ֥יבוּ לַחְמְכֶ֖ם בַּמִּשְׁקָ֑ל וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֖ם וְלֹ֥א תִשְׂבָּֽעוּ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: When I break for you [the] staff of bread, and will bake ten women your bread in one oven, and they will bring back your bread by weight, and you will eat and not you will be satisfied.

en.L: When I break your staff of bread, ten women will bake your bread in one oven, and they will bring back your bread by weight, and you will eat and not be satisfied.
en.B: When I break the staff that is your bread, there will be so little that ten women can bake it all in a single oven. They will hand it back to you weighed out, and you will eat and still be hungry.
en.R: I will take away your food supply. There will be so little flour that ten women will bake their bread in one oven. They will weigh out each person's share. You will eat, but you will still be hungry.
